verdicts.corrected_claim: The diagnostic is sound, but two details need correcting. The issue's reporter used a community fine-tune ('Qwen3.5-9B-DeepSeek-V4-Flash'), not Qwen3.8, and nobody bisected or confirmed the bug. Production llama.cpp is built from tag archive 'v0.6.0' (deploy/README.md), not a bNNNN build number, so the 'at or before b8533' comparison first requires mapping v0.6.0 to a build/commit.

verdicts.title: Handle Cyrillic/Latin homoglyphs explicitly: script hint plus mixed-script flag (never rewrite)
verdicts.reason: MDPBench (arxiv.org/html/2603.28130v1) contains the 'erroneously decoding Cyrillic characters that are visually identical to Latin letters' quote. ScriptMoE (arXiv 2609.24058v1, 21 Sep 2026) has 'The Russian gap stems from Cyrillic-Latin character confusion' verbatim. GlotOCR (2604.12978) has the 'Cyrillic and Thai also benefit notably...' sentence verbatim. Habr 966846 (16 Nov 2025) shows 'МОСКВА' -> 'MOCKBA' by PaddleOCR-VL. The OKO README normalizes 'похожие латинские и русские буквы'. sever/image_fusion.py:39-41 is exactly NFKC+casefold. A grep for кирил/latin/латин/cyrill in image_reader.py and image_agent.py finds nothing. A local scan of ground-truth-expanded-provisional.json values finds no mixed-script tokens; the only hit is a 'frame-000040@20.791133с' boundary note and file paths.

verdicts.title: Use a specialized literal OCR model as a veto on the cited crop (against 'plausible rewriting')
verdicts.reason: FaithC4 (arxiv 2607.21617, v2 dated 02 Sep 2026, Amazon) contains these as stated: 'rewrite it into a more plausible form'; Qwen3-VL 31.33% and Qwen3.5 27.35%; Tesseract/docTR 0%; the no-correction instruction 'reduces its magnitude by roughly 30–50%' for Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3.5-4B; pipelines 'median 93.5% vs. 68.6% F1'. MORE (2607.02956) gives HunyuanOCR 99.02, PaddleOCR-VL 98.31, dots.ocr 94.84, Qwen3-VL-2B 96.03, Cyrillic 91.45/90.01. GlotOCR Acc@5 is 86.8/86.0/83.5/79.0/78.0. Habr 1065182 gives PaddleOCR-VL 98.7/110.8 pages/min (A100, batch=1). Habr 993628 has the 'статистически вероятных словоформ' quote. sever/image_agent.py:71 has the abbreviation instruction.
verdicts.corrected_claim: The sources support the idea, but several caveats are missing. FaithC4 covers English, Chinese and Korean only, not Russian. 'Traditional OCR 0%' applies to Tesseract/docTR; PaddleOCR rewrote 7.87%. The 93.5% vs 68.6% figure comes from extracting ASINs (random 10-character strings) from 150 compliance PDFs. In that test the PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 pipeline was the WORST pipeline (74.48%), and direct Qwen3.5-4B reached 93.79%. That weakens PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 as a veto model. MORE cites the HunyuanOCR v1 report (arXiv 2511.19575), so its 99.02 Russian score is not evidence for HunyuanOCR-1.5. In Habr 993628 the 'likely word forms' statement is about handwritten text.

verdicts.title: Validate embedded ИНН with the existing local checksum as a confirmation veto
verdicts.reason: sever/inn.py:39 defines validate_inn with 10- and 12-digit control digits. inn.py:213 has the reason 'Conflicting literal own-role INNs; no majority/checksum selection'. sever/native_pipeline.py:1045-1046 sets inn_verification 'not_performed' with the quoted reason. Habr 1091144 (ScanReader, Zero-Trust) checks ИНН/СНИЛС/ОГРН/БИК/accounts algorithmically and quotes 'несуществующий ИНН с правильным форматом'.
verdicts.corrected_claim: The mechanism is verified. Three corrections: (a) In Habr 1091144 the 'tenfold amount error' describes an old evaluation-metric bug (scored 98.32%) that the new check rejects, not a VLM output. (b) Content AI 1021880 only suggests that the model could focus on 'проверке ИНН/КПП, дат и сумм'; it reports no tested result. (c) The provisional ground truth has only one labelled printed ИНН (7725382984, inside the 'ИНН/КПП 7725382984/860245001' block), and it passes the checksum. The labelled set therefore cannot measure the gain, and the parser must handle the 'ИНН/КПП digits/digits' layout.

verdicts.title: Targeted one-crop re-read for single-character confusable disagreements (Й/И, Ё/Е, 6/8, О/0)
verdicts.reason: CC-OCR v2 (arxiv 2605.03903v2, 10 Aug 2026) contains verbatim 'Shape-similar substitution instead results from confusion between visually similar characters' and 'Ambiguous seal patterns frequently induce hallucinated but visually plausible text'.
verdicts.corrected_claim: The MDPBench Hindi quote is a paraphrase. The paper says models 'tend to retain only the base characters and ignore crucial modifiers', not 'keep base characters and drop vowel diacritics'. As the report admits, no source quantifies Й/И or Ё/Е confusion in Russian, so the proposal rests on project data that has not been measured yet.

verdicts.title: Ask for grounding boxes in the Qwen-native relative 0-1000 integer convention
verdicts.reason: In QwenLM/Qwen3-VL issue #1616, HumanZhong (no role shown) wrote on 16 Oct 2025 'It is recommended to use option A for qwen2.5-vl and to use option B for qwen3-vl', where B means relative 0-1000 coordinates. Habr 953292 confirms MWS uses absolute 0-2048 coordinates; the authors first tried 0-1000 and switched. sever/image_agent.py:36 has Coordinate as float ge=0 le=1, and line 75 has the '[0, 1]' instruction.
verdicts.corrected_claim: The citation is accurate but weak evidence. The advice is about formatting FINE-TUNING data for Qwen2.5-VL vs Qwen3-VL in LLaMA-Factory, not inference prompting, and the commenter's affiliation is unknown. The only follow-up in the thread reports many wrong boxes on a KIE task. Nothing establishes the convention for Qwen3.6 or Qwen3.8.

verdicts.title: Set expectations and consider an 'OCR draft + VLM verify' path for УПД/ТОРГ-12
verdicts.reason: Habr contentai 1021880 (10 Apr) gives the PTR figures as stated: УПД ContentCapture 2.67%, VLM-only 4%, hybrid LLaMA-4 36.67%, Qwen2.5-VL-7B 23.3%; ТОРГ-12 IDP-only 0%, best cloud VLM about 41%, hybrid 80%, local Mistral 51%. The documents are synthetic and near-ideal. FaithC4 gives 93.5% vs 68.6%.
verdicts.corrected_claim: One cited claim is refuted. Habr 993628 does NOT say VLMs 'confuse nearby number and date fields'. It says universal VLMs make more table-structure errors, and that line/column splitting errors are a general problem. The FaithC4 pipeline figure comes from random ASIN strings, and its PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 pipeline scored below the direct VLMs.

missing: Segmentation is the largest measured accuracy loss (8/20 target intervals missed), and the report proposes nothing for it; all findings target reading.

MWS also lists Qwen3.8 Flash (val img->text 0.842, KIE 0.833, grounding 0.301; test 0.836/0.832/0.264), which beats Qwen3.8-27B on all three axes. The report never checks whether Qwen3.8 Flash is open-weight and small enough to run locally. If it is, it would be the most obvious A/B candidate, since it keeps the grounding advantage.

Qwen3.6-27B and 35B-A3B use hybrid Gated DeltaNet linear attention (the 27B card shows 64 layers: 48 linear, 16 full attention; the report says '16 of 65'). llama.cpp's prompt-prefix reuse for recurrent/linear-attention state is more limited than for pure KV models. About 73% of V7 input tokens were prefix-cache reads, so a swap could lose cache hits and erase part of the MoE speed gain. This needs measuring, for example via cache_n in the phase1 per-call counters.
The cited unsloth 35B-A3B MTP GGUF does not support --mmproj with MTP. A vision deployment needs the non-MTP GGUF and must keep enable_thinking=false; Qwen3.6 defaults to thinking.

deploy/ab_speed_test.sh A/Bs git refs against a fixed model server and explicitly never touches the model service. A model A/B needs a separate procedure (swap local-model.env, restart sever-model, rerun the same ref) and must still respect the shared inference lock.
Production llama.cpp is tag v0.6.0, not a bNNNN build, so the b8533/b8545 regression check needs a commit mapping.
Cotype Light 3 (MWS AI, 9B): no open weights or license was found, and its scores come from the vendor's own benchmark. Treat it as not locally usable until weights are published.

HunyuanOCR-1.5 Cyrillic evidence: MORE evaluated HunyuanOCR v1 (cites arXiv 2511.19575), so the 99.02 Russian score does not transfer to 1.5. The Tencent Hunyuan Community License territory restrictions should be checked for a Russian deployment.

PaddleOCR-VL-1.5: ServerFlow places it in the bottom pair overall and weak on tables and handwriting, not 'last on Russian tables and handwriting'. Its license is still unverified in the fetched sources.
No cost estimate for the 4 hard leaves (72% of calls), which are the main speed lever: e.g. whether simply capping per-leaf calls or frames would beat any model swap.
